message: init --help says it creates .pebbl/, PEBBL.md and an AGENTS.md block. It does not say it installs pre-commit, pre-push, post-commit, post-merge and post-checkout hooks, and it overwrote an existing pre-commit hook in ~/dev-tools without a backup or a warning. Ask: list the hooks in --help, and back up or refuse when a non-pebbl hook already exists.

init --shared on a store previously created by plain init leaves the blanket '.pebbl/' line in .gitignore. It appends the named ignores and '!.pebbl/events.jsonl', but git does not descend into a blanket-ignored directory, so events.jsonl stays ignored and shared mode commits nothing. The command prints 'Added .pebbl/events.jsonl (SHARED - committed)' anyway. Seen in ~/dev-tools 2026-10-07; fixed there by deleting the blanket line by hand. Expected: --shared removes the blanket line, or refuses and says why.
